description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the Midas pond at its grandest: a large turquoise pond with a grey hewn stone edge and a stone pier, a big water wheel with iron rims turning a long stone-and-timber gold sluice, iron-bound chests and sacks of shining gold nuggets on the bank, no house, no hut

references.usage: the previous, third stage of this same building in the camp, chosen by the author: keep its idea, colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw its fourth, grandest stage, rebuilt for the stronghold with grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron
